\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی} (harim-e khosusi)}{حریم خصوصی (harim-e khosusi)}]{\fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی} (harim-e khosusi) — privacy}

\label{lesson:FA-C419-harim-e-khosusi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to upload, then the Persian for technical support.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی}}
\textbf{\fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی}} (\emph{harim-e khosusi}) — \textquotedblleft{}privacy\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{برنامه} \fa{به} \fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی} \fa{ما} \fa{احترام} \fa{نمیگذارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{in barnâme be harim-e khosusi-ye mâ ehterâm nemigozârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This app does not respect our privacy.
\end{quote}

\emph{Harim} \textquotedblleft{}protected space\textquotedblright{} + ezafe + \emph{khosusi} \textquotedblleft{}private\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{حریم} \fa{خصوصی}} is literally \textquotedblleft{}the private protected space\textquotedblright{}: \emph{harim} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{ḥarīm} \textquotedblleft{}a protected precinct\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{khosusi} to Arabic \emph{khuṣūṣī} \textquotedblleft{}particular, private\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{harim-e khosusi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{harim-e khosusi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{harim-e khosusi}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to upload, then the Persian for technical support, then say \emph{harim-e khosusi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{هک} \fa{کردن} (hak kardan)}{هک کردن (hak kardan)}]{\fa{هک} \fa{کردن} (hak kardan) — to hack}

\label{lesson:FA-C419-hak-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for technical support, then the Persian for privacy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{هک} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{هک} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{hak kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to hack\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{کسی} \fa{حساب} \fa{ایمیل} \fa{او} \fa{را} \fa{هک} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kasi hesâb-e imeyl-e u râ hak kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Someone hacked his email account.
\end{quote}

An English loan + \emph{kardan}. \emph{Hak shodan} — to be hacked.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{هک} \fa{کردن}} joins the English loan \emph{hack} to the inherited Persian verb \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{ویروس} (virus)}{ویروس (virus)}]{\fa{ویروس} (virus) — a virus}

\label{lesson:FA-C419-virus}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for privacy, then the Persian for to hack.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{ویروس}}
\textbf{\fa{ویروس}} (\emph{virus}) — \textquotedblleft{}a virus\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{کامپیوترم} \fa{ویروس} \fa{گرفته} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kâmpyuteram virus gerefte ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My computer has caught a virus.
\end{quote}

For computers and for illness alike.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{ویروس}} came into Persian from European languages, usually traced through French \emph{virus} to Latin \emph{vīrus} \textquotedblleft{}slime, poison\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short).
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشتن} (be eshterâk gozâshtan)}{به اشتراک گذاشتن (be eshterâk gozâshtan)}]{\fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشتن} (be eshterâk gozâshtan) — to share (online)}

\label{lesson:FA-C419-be-eshterak-gozashtan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to hack, then the Persian for a virus.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشتن}}
\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشتن}} (\emph{be eshterâk gozâshtan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to share (online)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{عکسهای} \fa{سفرش} \fa{را} \fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u 'akshâ-ye safarash râ be eshterâk gozâsht.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
She shared the photos from her trip.
\end{quote}

\emph{Eshterâk} \textquotedblleft{}sharing; subscription\textquotedblright{} + \emph{gozâshtan} \textquotedblleft{}to put\textquotedblright{} (stem \emph{gozâr-}).

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{اشتراک} \fa{گذاشتن}} is literally \textquotedblleft{}to put into sharing\textquotedblright{}: \emph{eshterâk} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{ishtirāk} \textquotedblleft{}sharing, taking part\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{gozâshtan} \textquotedblleft{}to put\textquotedblright{} is native Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{be eshterâk gozâshtan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{be eshterâk gozâshtan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to hack, then the Persian for a virus, then say \emph{be eshterâk gozâshtan} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی} (hush-e masnu'i)}{هوش مصنوعی (hush-e masnu'i)}]{\fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی} (hush-e masnu'i) — artificial intelligence}

\label{lesson:FA-C419-hush-e-masnui}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a virus, then the Persian for to share.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی}}
\textbf{\fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی}} (\emph{hush-e masnu'i}) — \textquotedblleft{}artificial intelligence\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی} \fa{کار} \fa{خیلی} \fa{از} \fa{مردم} \fa{را} \fa{عوض} \fa{میکند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{hush-e masnu'i kâr-e kheyli az mardom râ 'avaz mikonad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Artificial intelligence is changing many people's work.
\end{quote}

\emph{Hush} \textquotedblleft{}intelligence\textquotedblright{} + ezafe + \emph{masnu'i} \textquotedblleft{}artificial\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{هوش} \fa{مصنوعی}} joins \emph{hush} \textquotedblleft{}intelligence\textquotedblright{}, which EtymDB traces to a Middle Persian word for consciousness, to \emph{masnu'i} \textquotedblleft{}artificial\textquotedblright{}, built on Arabic \emph{maṣnū'} \textquotedblleft{}made\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
